summary: Hello Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026, with no special-situation events. The filing reports a 5.3% year-over-year net revenue decline to RMB2,386.0 million and non-GAAP net income of RMB328.8 million. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is mentioned. As a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
